00:54:40	marc | wolovim:	Justin’s agenda comment:

Topic: removing the claimed index from AA-VOPS by splitting verification into NON_STATE / STATE

Problem: 8369 judges an omitted frame tx at an index the builder picks, so a frame tx is only protected if it's valid at every index. Nonce chains and shared payers can get excused this way. The index exists because end-of-block would make builders re-check after every append, and each Profile 2 re-check replays the whole VERIFY prefix, crypto included.

Idea: check the NON_STATE part (signature/proof) once when the IL arrives and cache it. After each append, only re-check STATE (key binding, nonces, roots, payer). Re-checks get about as cheap as Profile 1's, so frame txs can use the same end-of-block check
00:55:12	Daniil Ankushin | Nethermind:	Reacted to "had a concern for MAX_VERIFY_GAS that i added here https://github.com/ethereum/go-ethereum/pull/36095#discussion_r4600264115" with 👀
00:55:38	Daniil Ankushin | Nethermind:	Reacted to "Yeah both changes are good and important (would even advocate to try to push higher if performance allows). Soispoke didn't seem to worry about the verify gas limit and FOCIL interaction" with ❤️
00:55:52	Daniil Ankushin | Nethermind:	Reacted to "Justin’s agenda comment:

Topic: removing the claimed index from AA-VOPS by splitting verification into NON_STATE / STATE

Problem: 8369 judges an omitted frame tx at an index the builder picks, so a frame tx is only protected if it's valid at every index. Nonce chains and shared payers can get excused this way. The index exists because end-of-block would make builders re-check after every append, and each Profile 2 re-check replays the whole VERIFY prefix, crypto included.

Idea: check the NON_STATE part (signature/proof) once when the IL arrives and cache it. After each append, only re-check STATE (key binding, nonces, roots, payer). Re-checks get about as cheap as Profile 1's, so frame txs can use the same end-of-block check" with 👀
